items.title: Muru
items.text: Muru Graham Dumpleton started mod_wsgi 20 years ago, and has been thinking about the ideal way to serve Python web applications in production ever since. Muru is his new, AI-assisted Rust server that aims to provide the best possible tools for running ASGI and WSGI Python apps both in development and production. As he did with wrapture , he's been publishing an extraordinarily detailed account of the project as he works on it - as part of his development process. Here's everything he's published

items.title: Quoting Ravi Vakil
items.text: Alessandro Masullo has a proposed proof of [Generalized Riemann Hypothesis], and Brian Conrad has been looking closely at it for months and gave extensive feedback which is being incorporated, and it is so far looking good. It is all human, with no AI. The hope was to bring Alessandro to Stanford for a year to polish the writing and then announce it after running it by enough people. Now it seems best to put out the current draft. — Ravi Vakil , Hurried Announcement: Alessandro Masullo GRH

items.title: Quoting Levent Alpöge
items.text: I believe I have, working with Claude, discovered a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis. In fact, the method easily extends much further, resolving the so-called Generalized Riemann Hypothesis, and I expect, with more time, the Extended Riemann Hypothesis too. Claude and I have also formalized the arguments without assumptions. It is natural to feel that this is an end, in my case a loss of a principal guiding light, but what I saw during the course of progress so amazed me that I believe it is one
